mentions.name: Letterboxd for video-games
mentions.description: A video-game cataloging and logging platform inspired by Letterboxd, letting users track, rate, and review the video games they play. The project also serves as a learning exercise in front-end design and database design.
mentions.source_excerpt: Letterboxd for video-games! Don't know if it's novel enough but it's given me the chance to get into front-end design and think harder about database design.
